# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/topics

Replace list of topics for a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write access required) · **ID:** `ep-348`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `api.RepoTopicOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `topics` | []string | True | max 25 topics, each topic: max 35 chars, matches ^[a-z0-9][-.a-z0-9]*$ |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Repository not found
- **422** — Invalid topic names or exceeding max 25 topics

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Topic names must match pattern ^[a-z0-9][-.a-z0-9]*$ and be max 35 chars | validation | len(topic) > 35 || !topicPattern.MatchString(topic) |
| Maximum 25 topics allowed per repository | validation | len(validTopics) > 25 |
| SaveTopics computes diff between current and desired topics, only adding/removing changes | business_logic | Always on UpdateTopics |
| Topic repo_count is maintained as a denormalized counter, incremented on add, decremented on remove | business_logic | Topic added or removed from repo |
| After topic changes, the repository.topics field is synced with current topic names | business_logic | After any topic add/remove/save |

### Error Paths

- **More than 25 valid topics** → UpdateTopics → 422
- **Invalid topic names** → UpdateTopics → 422
- **DB error in SaveTopics** → UpdateTopics → 500
